def transform(x):
    """
    Return the list of integers from 1 to 10, omitting the number that equals
    the length of the input list (if that length is between 1 and 10 inclusive).
    """
    n = len(x)
    return [i for i in range(1, 11) if i != n] if 1 <= n <= 10 else list(range(1, 11))
